parameters.query: SELECT id, name, email, phone, color, role, notification_preferences, avatar_url, email_signature, location FROM users WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC;
SELECT (SELECT u.name FROM contacts c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.id = $1) AS old_owner_name;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE contacts SET owner_id = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, owner_id, first_name, last_name
), mv AS (
  -- Upcoming, not-yet-completed calendar events of this contact follow the new owner (tasks are left alone).
  UPDATE activities a SET user_id = $1::int
  FROM upd
  WHERE a.contact_id = upd.id AND $1::int IS NOT NULL AND a.type <> 'task' AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL
    AND a.due_at > now() AND a.is_completed = false AND a.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM $1::int
  RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT upd.id, upd.owner_id, upd.first_name, upd.last_name, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM mv) AS moved_events FROM upd;
SELECT (SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1) AS new_owner_name;

parameters.query: UPDATE users SET theme_header_color = $1, theme_main_color = $2, theme_accent_color = $3 WHERE id = $4 RETURNING id, name, theme_header_color, theme_main_color, theme_accent_color;
UPDATE users SET notification_preferences = COALESCE(notification_preferences, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, name, notification_preferences;
SELECT id, name, email, phone, color, role, active, created_at, avatar_url, email_signature, location FROM users ORDER BY active DESC, name ASC;
UPDATE users SET role = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, name, role;
UPDATE users SET avatar_url = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, name, avatar_url;
UPDATE users SET phone = NULLIF($1, '') WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, name, phone;
